notes: Human-reviewed source-only plan for request-derived object-property writes. This fixture contains no expected locations or answer-key labels.

vectors.title: Review request-derived computed property writes
vectors.rationale: A request-derived key written into a regular object requires ownership and dangerous-key boundary review.

reviewObligations.riskStatement: A request-derived key may reach a computed property write without a source-backed ownership or dangerous-key control.
reviewObligations.evidenceRequirement: The review identifies both the computed write operation and request-derived key condition.

limitations: Static review does not prove session middleware behavior or caller reachability.
